_description: Release-blocking defect registry consumed by scripts/release_blocking_gate.py (R8 / task 13.4, Requirement 12.5, design Property 22). A v1.0.0 release is BLOCKED when any defect with an OPEN status carries priority P0 (critical) or P1 (high). This gate is COMPLEMENTARY to the release-candidate gate (scripts/rc-gate.sh, task 12.5): BOTH must pass to ship (task 13.6). The gate DERIVES the block decision from each defect's priority + status; it never trusts a hand-set 'blocking' boolean, so a mis-labelled P0 can never slip through.
requirement: 12.5 — IF an open defect carries priority P0 or P1 THEN the release pipeline SHALL block the v1.0.0 tag.

schema.priority: one of P0 (critical) | P1 (high) | P2 (medium) | P3 (low/unspecified). Synonyms accepted case-insensitively: critical/blocker->P0, high->P1, medium/moderate->P2, low/unspecified/none/trivial->P3.
schema.status: free text; a defect is treated as OPEN (block-eligible) unless its status is a known closed status (resolved|closed|fixed|done|wontfix|deferred|duplicate|invalid|not_applicable|not-applicable|verified). Unknown/missing status => OPEN (fail-closed).
schema.blocking_rule: a defect blocks the release IFF priority in {P0,P1} AND status is open.

auto_sources.vuln_summary: docs/sbom/vuln-summary.json (task 12.2) is auto-ingested by the gate: each 'critical' finding becomes a synthetic OPEN P0 defect and each 'high' becomes a synthetic OPEN P1, so a future critical/high CVE auto-blocks the release even if no one hand-adds it here. Currently critical=0 and high=0, so it contributes zero blocking defects.

defects.title: 10 dependency/toolchain advisories (govulncheck Go daemon+TUI), all UNSPECIFIED severity
defects.note: govulncheck reported 10 findings across the Go daemon (6) and TUI (4); cargo audit, dotnet, and SPM are clean. severity_totals = {critical:0, high:0, moderate:0, low:0, unspecified:10}. Per Requirement 11.3 the security gate blocks only on CRITICAL, so these are triage-only, NOT release-blocking (classified P3, matching their unspecified severity). Remediation (owned by go-daemon-dev, not this gate): rebuild the daemon+TUI with go1.26.5+ to clear the 9 stdlib advisories and bump google.golang.org/grpc v1.64.0 -> v1.79.3 to clear the reachable gRPC authorization-bypass GO-2026-4762. Recorded honestly; does not block v1.0.0.

defects.title: verify.sh reported macOS unit+integration FAIL under the live desktop-e2e e2e lane (STATUS.md 2026-07-20)
defects.note: Recorded honestly from the STATUS board so this gate does not hide a known-red signal. It is INDEPENDENTLY enforced by the complementary release-candidate gate (scripts/rc-gate.sh, task 12.5), which requires verify.sh GREEN before shipping — so the release cannot proceed while this is red regardless of its priority here (that is the 'both gates must pass' design, task 13.6). Priority is P2 (tracked, not P0/P1) to avoid double-counting the RC gate's verify.sh enforcement: the discrepancy is diagnosis-pending (swiftui-dev / swift-test-engineer), the prior green run (74.2%) predates the current Sources/ + daemon changes, and per-task builds/tests since have been individually green, so it may be a live-lane/timing artifact rather than a product regression. If triage confirms a product regression, raise this to P1 and this gate will block.
